# Data Correctness Requirements Checklist: GymTracker v1

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements governing stored values and derived calculations — nutrition scaling, rounding, goal effective-dating, and training volume — are complete, unambiguous, and objectively verifiable before implementation begins.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the rounding policy stated as a requirement rather than only as a technical decision? [Gap, Research §R4 vs Spec §Requirements] — resolved by FR-044, FR-045
- [x] CHK002 Are display precision rules defined for each quantity type — energy, macros, body weight, lift weight, portion amounts? [Completeness, Gap] — resolved by FR-044
- [x] CHK003 Is the training volume formula stated in a functional requirement, or only in the Assumptions section? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031, §Assumptions] — resolved by FR-031b
- [x] CHK004 Is the week-boundary definition for weekly volume aggregation specified in the requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-031] — resolved by FR-031c (ISO weeks, Monday start)
- [x] CHK005 Is the body weight "net change" calculation defined, including its behavior with fewer than two data points? [Gap, Spec §FR-030] — resolved by FR-030c
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for what happens to historical meal entries when a food's nutrition values are edited? [Gap, Spec §FR-023, §FR-024] — resolved by FR-024c, FR-024d
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for the effect on past days when a goal set is deleted? [Gap, Spec §FR-025c] — resolved by FR-025e
- [x] CHK008 Is the number of accepted decimal places specified for each numeric input? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases] — resolved by FR-046
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for how locale-specific decimal separators are handled or rejected? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases] — resolved by FR-047

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 Is "proportionally" in the macro scaling requirement defined with an explicit formula? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020a] — resolved by FR-020a, now stating `value × (quantityGrams ÷ portionGrams)`
- [x] CHK011 Is "a single documented formula" for volume actually pointing at a specific, locatable definition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031] — resolved by FR-031a (one implementation) and FR-031b (the formula)
- [x] CHK012 Is "the heaviest weight logged per session date" unambiguous when multiple sessions exist on one date? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-032, §FR-011] — resolved by FR-032a (max across all that date's sets)
- [x] CHK013 Is the tie-breaking rule specified when two sets share the heaviest weight on the same date? [Gap, Spec §FR-032] — resolved by FR-032a: the result is a single value, so ties need no rule
- [x] CHK014 Is "the goal in effect on that date" defined precisely enough to resolve a goal set whose effective date equals the queried date? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025a, Research §R5] — resolved by FR-025a, now explicit that "on or before" includes the date itself
- [x] CHK015 Is "calendar date without time-of-day" resolved against a specific clock — client timezone or server timezone? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions, Research §R10] — resolved by FR-048, FR-048a, FR-049

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 Does the "totals match exactly" success criterion reconcile with the rounding policy, or do the two conflict? [Conflict, Spec §SC-006 vs Research §R4] — resolved by rewritten SC-006
- [x] CHK017 Is the principle that history stays stable applied consistently — goals are effective-dated, but food nutrition edits rewrite past entries? [Conflict, Spec §FR-025b vs §FR-024] — resolved by FR-024c
- [x] CHK018 Are the units used in requirements consistent across workout weight, body weight, and food quantity? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions] — verified: kg / g / kcal throughout; §Assumptions now also covers liquids as grams
- [x] CHK019 Do the servings-and-grams equivalence criterion and the stored-quantity requirement describe the same rounding behavior? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006b, §FR-020] — resolved by FR-046a: derived quantities keep full precision, so both paths store the same value
- [x] CHK020 Are the data model's derived-value formulas consistent with the functional requirements that describe them? [Consistency, Data Model §Derived values] — verified after the volume-owner correction; every formula now matches FR-020a, FR-030c, FR-031b

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Can "match exactly" be objectively evaluated given that displayed values are rounded? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006] — resolved by rewritten SC-006, which states the comparison precisely
- [x] CHK022 Is the success criterion for goal resolution stated in a way that can be checked without reading the implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006a] — verified: SC-006a is expressed purely in terms of observable output
- [x] CHK023 Is there a measurable criterion covering volume calculation correctness, equivalent to the ones covering nutrition totals? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria] — resolved by SC-011
- [x] CHK024 Does a success criterion exist for the correctness of per-day goal values across a range where goals changed mid-range? [Coverage, Spec §FR-033, §SC-006a] — resolved by SC-012

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a zero-volume session composed entirely of bodyweight sets? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, §FR-031] — resolved by FR-031d
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for days falling before the earliest goal set within a progress range? [Coverage, Spec §FR-033, §FR-028] — resolved by FR-033a
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for extremely large numeric inputs, or is an upper bound specified for weights, portions, and goals? [Gap, Spec §FR-036] — resolved by FR-036a
- [x] CHK028 Is the relationship between a food's calorie value and its macro values constrained, or explicitly left unvalidated? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, §FR-024] — resolved by FR-016a: deliberately unvalidated, with the reason stated

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK029 Is the assumption that a single unit system suffices validated against the food catalog, which may need volume-based portions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — resolved: §Assumptions now states liquids are expressed in grams at 1 ml ≈ 1 g, with the inaccuracy accepted
- [x] CHK030 Is the assumption that floating-point accumulation is safe at this data scale documented where requirement authors will see it? [Assumption, Research §R4] — resolved: promoted from research into §Assumptions "Numeric precision"

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
